artifacts.summary: Audits typst/FormalFoundations.typ against the current Lean tree and paper-definitions-of-record: renamed identifiers and Some/All Past/Future labels are already clean; finds a wrong axiom-count remark (claims 22/5 constructors where Lean has 11/4), a pervasive TB->TS and TA->TC key mislabeling (7 sites each), and a structural naming collision between this document's TM (BL-level, no current paper counterpart) and TM^+ (which is what the current paper actually calls plain TM).

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md's 'Language correspondence (2026-09-08)' section (mid-file, inside the drift-correction log) is the authoritative, permanent record of how repository object-language names (L, TM, L-, TM-, L+, TM+, L*) map onto the paper's manuscript systems (only two: BL-collapsed-language and its stability extension). Key fact: the paper withdrew its H/G-primitive tense fragment entirely; the repository's L-/TM- (FormalSystem/Syntax/MinusLanguage/) has NO paper counterpart and must never be described as a direct paper transcription. docs/reference/axiom-reference.md's 'Paper Key Correspondence' table and FormalSystem/ProofSystem/Axioms.lean's module docstring are the ground truth for axiom constructor counts (29 total: 19 core + 4 uniformity + 1 prior + 1 Z1 + 2 density + 2 Reynolds Dedekind) -- prose elsewhere (e.g. typst/FormalFoundations.typ) should be checked against these two files directly rather than trusted or re-derived from older prose.
